Quick answer

Messify is an affordable meal subscription in Dubai. Plans cost AED 215–610 a week or AED 715–1,999 a month for 1 to 3 meals a day, which works out to AED 25.63–30.71 per meal. All of the day's meals arrive together every morning, and you can skip a day and use that meal later in your plan.

How it works

Your mornings, sorted in four steps.

  1. Pick your plan

    1, 2 or 3 meals a day, weekly or monthly.

  2. Check tomorrow's menu

    The menu changes every day. See it in the app and choose your meals by 6 PM.

  3. Get your bag

    All your meals arrive together each morning, packed with an ice pack.

  4. Heat and eat

    Meals are blast-chilled after cooking. A few minutes to reheat and you're done.

The token system

Plans change. Your meals don't go to waste.

1 meal = 1 token

Your plan fills your wallet: 7, 14 or 21 tokens a week, or 26, 52 or 78 a month.

Skip a day, eat it later

Travelling or eating out? Skip in the app and use that token on another day of your plan.

Double up when you need to

Two lunches today, or a friend coming over? Spend an extra token.

Questions

Good to know.

Ask a question

How much does a meal plan cost in Dubai with Messify?

Weekly plans cost AED 215, 415 or 610 for 1, 2 or 3 meals a day. Monthly plans cost AED 715, 1,400 or 1,999. That works out to AED 25.63 to 30.71 per meal.

What's the difference between weekly and monthly plans?

Monthly plans are 26 days of meals to use within 30 days, and save you more on every meal. Weekly plans are 7 days of meals to use within 9 days, the easy way to try us out first.

Can I skip a day?

Yes. Skip a day in the app and use that token on another day of your plan.

Can I order extra meals?

Yes. Two lunches in one day, or a friend coming over? Spend an extra token.

When do meals arrive?

Every morning, all together in one Messify bag with an ice pack. Meals are blast-chilled, so you reheat them when you're ready to eat.

Can I see the menu in advance?

Yes. The menu changes every day, and tomorrow's menu is in the app the day before. Choose your meals by 6 PM for next-morning delivery.

Is Messify food halal?

Yes. All Messify meals are 100% halal.

Do you have vegetarian meals?

Yes. There is a vegetarian option every day, for every meal: breakfast, lunch and dinner.

Which areas do you deliver meal plans to?

We deliver meal plans every morning to three areas: Dubai Academic City, Dubai Silicon Oasis and International City. Message us on WhatsApp to check your building.

How do I start a meal plan?

Download the Messify app, pick your plan and pay in the app. Prefer to talk first? Message us on WhatsApp at +971 50 251 3033.
